decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module in a German B2B electronics firm, its early and still uncertain results would usually justify continued support unless it clearly falls below aspiration levels, and a website mention suggests at least baseline commitment.

Its dedicated product page signals stronger managerial commitment and perceived fit with the firm's industrial electronics portfolio, so under bounded rationality and with no clear failure signal it is likely to be retained.

The relay module appears somewhat less emphasized than a flagship offering, but it still fits the established industrial module business and would typically be kept while management learns whether performance reaches aspiration levels.

The server room monitoring kit looks more peripheral and experimentally positioned than the core module products, raising the risk of problemistic reallocation, but its newness and possible organisational slack still make near-term retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
